chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Samaan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "When you recite the prostration verse, prostrate and do not say Takbir until you raise your head."

key_terms.السَّجْدَةَ: The prostration verse or the act of prostration

ai.seo_question: When should one say Takbir during prostration in prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights a specific juristic nuance in the Hanafi-Shia divergence regarding the timing of the Takbir during prostration of recitation (sajdat al-tilawah). It emphasizes the continuity of the prostration act itself, suggesting that the verbal glorification should follow the physical completion of the bowing motion rather than interrupting it, a view supported by Shia scholars like Al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*. This ruling underscores the precision required in ritual worship, linking physical posture directly to verbal devotion.
